title: Find a Tote by Location Number on the Container Selection Screen (select rack or AGV)
summary: Use the Container Selection screen to locate a tote by entering a location number and selecting the rack or AGV where it is located (when it exists in the system).
when_to_use: When you need to find a tote in the system using a known location number, and you want to identify which rack or AGV it is on from the Container Selection screen.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the location-based tote lookup on the Container Selection screen and confirm the tote number appears after selecting the correct rack/AGV.
access_or_tools_needed: Rack/AGV selection controls on the Container Selection screen

access_required: Access to the Container Selection screen
system_preconditions: The tote must be present in the system for it to appear after selecting the appropriate rack or AGV.

visual_references.description: Container Selection screen frame showing: dark blue (tote present), light blue (empty rack), and the instruction to find a tote by typing a Location number and selecting the rack or AGV where it is located (if in the system).

steps.title: Open the Container Selection screen
steps.purpose: Access the UI needed to search for a tote by location number.
steps.instruction: Open the Container Selection screen in the RMS UI.
steps.expected_result: The Container Selection screen is displayed with the rack/AGV selection area and the Location input field available.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the Container Selection UI elements used for selecting a rack/AGV and entering a Location number.
steps.failure_condition: The Container Selection screen is not available or the Location input field / rack-AGV selection controls are not visible.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: 'You can also find a tote by typing the location number in and selecting the rack or AGV it's located on if it's in the system.'

steps.title: Enter the location number in the Location field
steps.purpose: Provide the location number used for the tote lookup.
steps.instruction: In the Container Selection screen, type the location number into the Location field.
steps.expected_result: The Location field contains the location number you intend to search for.
steps.healthy_condition: The Location input field is populated with the correct location number.
steps.failure_condition: The Location field is empty or contains an incorrect value.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: 'You can also find a tote by typing the - - , Location 11801070 number in ...'

steps.title: Select the rack or AGV where the tote is located
steps.purpose: Direct the lookup to the correct rack/AGV so the tote can be found (when present).
steps.instruction: Select the rack or AGV where the tote is located on the Container Selection screen.
steps.expected_result: After selecting the rack/AGV, the UI reflects the tote presence for that selection (when the tote exists in the system).
steps.healthy_condition: The selected rack/AGV shows the tote-present indicator (dark blue indicates presence of a tote).
steps.failure_condition: The selected rack/AGV shows the empty-rack indicator (light blue) or no tote appears for the entered location number.

actions.label: Select rack/AGV
actions.exact_action: selecting the rack or AGV it's located on

stop_or_escalate_if: If no tote appears for the entered location number, do not assume it exists—stop and escalate or try a different documented location number.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: 'Dark blue indicates the presence of a ... tote. While light blue represents empty ... rack.'
OCR: '...selecting the rack or AGV it's located on if its in the system.'

steps.title: Verify the tote appears in the Container Selection results
steps.purpose: Confirm the lookup succeeded and identify the tote number.
steps.instruction: Check the Container Selection results for the selected rack/AGV and verify the tote appears (tote number shown when selected).
steps.expected_result: The tote is found in the system and the Container Selection UI shows the tote number after selecting the appropriate rack or AGV.
steps.healthy_condition: A tote number is displayed for the selected rack/AGV (tote-present state).
steps.failure_condition: No tote number is displayed for the selected rack/AGV for the entered location number.

actions.label: Confirm tote number
actions.exact_action: Verify the tote appears in the Container Selection results (tote number shown when selected).

stop_or_escalate_if: If no tote appears for the entered location number, do not assume it exists—stop and escalate or try a different documented location number.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: 'If you select it, a box icon will show ... as well as the tote number.'

success_criteria: After entering a location number and selecting the correct rack/AGV, the Container Selection UI shows the tote number for that selection.
healthy_conditions: Selected rack/AGV indicates tote presence (dark blue) and displays a tote number when selected.
failure_conditions: Selected rack/AGV indicates empty rack (light blue) and no tote number appears for the entered location number.
escalation_guidance: If no tote appears for the entered location number, do not assume it exists—stop and escalate or try a different documented location number.
